Formulated Without Parabens, Fragrance, Allergens, Alcohol, Mineral Oil, Testing on Animals Clinical Results Ultra Light sunscreen has been tested by a leading independent third-party (Centre for Cruelty Free Testing) for the following claims: ⚫ In Vitro test: SPF 54.58 PA ++++ ⚫ In Vivo* test: SPF 50.17 PA++++ ⚫ Lightest Sunscreen in India: Comparative testing with top-selling Indian competitors; determined through a blind sensorial study conducted on 32 volunteers by an independent third-party ⚫ Free from Harmful Endocrine Disruptors: Phthalates, Parabens, UV Filters (Octisalate, Homosalate, Octocrylene, Oxybenzone, Octinoxate, Avobenzone), Triclosan, Lead, and Cadmium ⚫ Dermatologically Tested: Verified for skin irritation as per the IS 4011: 2018 standard ⚫ Sweat & Water Resistant: Upto 80 mins * Note: In Vivo test is the GOLD STANDARD for SPF test. It directly measures sunscreen effectiveness on human skin, ensuring accurate and reliable results. How to Use? Ultra Light Sunscreen On cleansed and toned skin, apply a generous amount of sunscreen on the face and neck. Body Sunscreen Spray Spray generously around your body and gently massage it in. Important Information To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this Ultra Light SPF 50+ Sunscreen regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or less if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product,; you can safely use it Suitable for • All skin types Helps • Protect skin from UVA and UVB rays • Deeply hydrates skin • Improve skin tone • Targets and heals acne • Leaves skin feeling smooth Clinical Proof Lab Tests and Certifications In Vivo SPF Test View Certificate In Vitro SPF Test View Certificate No Hormone Disruptors View Certificate Non Irritant Test View Certificate Ratings & Reviews 4.7 176 Reviews 5 117 4 57 3 2 2 1 Easy application & light The spray format is sooo unique makes body sunscreen application sooo easy. Frequently asked questions About Daily Sun Shield Kit Is this suitable for all skin types? This kit is suitable for all skin types. SunCat DE present in body sunscreen spray makes it safe even for sensitive skin. AcZero technology present in our ultra light sunscreen makes it completely safe even for active acne or acne-prone skin. But since every skin type is different, we recommend doing a patch test before incorporating it in your routine. Will this leave a white cast? No, both our sunscreens blend and absorb in just 3 seconds, leaving no white cast. Does it have fragrance? No, both our sunscreens are fragrance free. Is it sweat/water resistant? Yes, it is clinically proven to have water & sweat resistance, upto 80 mins.
